name: Satsuma (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Satsuma town emblem in green, blue and red: green stylised hills above a blue swirl, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Satsuma, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 2005.

features.role: Satsuma town emblem — green stylised hills above a blue swirl, with a red disc
